messages.author: Unknown Identity
messages.text:
My idea is to recommend adding a war budget, make maintaining an army a costly investment. Instead of just using rations to recruit troops and feed them. Now i want to add the ability to pay them on an hourly basis, same for ships, planes and missiles, they should cost money not just resources to maintain and upkeep. 

If this suggestion seems likely to pass, I will use my experience in the US military to figure out realistic costs and apply them here for dede to implement.

messages.author: Unknown Identity
messages.text:
Add recruitment office to turn manpower into trained recruits over time. Idea from Ieb suggestion of reserve base to train units. 

Increase food intake by all units. Not just troops. A ship still needs to feed its sailors. Thanks to Chelovka.  

Possibly adding a training time (could be implemented into recruitment office or by adding training facilities) with policies allowing for draft (rapid training with poor stats) to full training (longer but troops/sailors emerge with higher stats and in theory less likely to die) Idea courtesy of Chelovka. 

Tie manpower/recruits/troops/pilots/sailors to population and a costly war that sees thousands if not millions of military dying actually affect population. If 1 soldier dies, 1 population dies. Courtesy of AndythHusky


More ideas to come.
